explanation: Matches Theorem 3.1 of Das–Dey–Sharma (arXiv 2604.08040v1): cyc(G) < 5·2^(t-2) implies G nilpotent. Natural-number subtraction changes the bound only at t = 0, 1, where it reads 5 instead of a fractional value, and both cases are true since those groups are trivial or p-groups. At t = 2 it is sharp on S_3 with cyc = 5, matching Remark 3.2. Faithful.
